courses.title: Lecture: Numerical Methods for Wave Propagation
courses.exam: continuous assessment — PASS/FAIL: Solving the weekly homework (50% points in theoretical and programming exercises) + 30 min oral exam in June/July 2026.
courses.admission:
Admission requirements	The lecture builds upon the first part "Numerical Methods for PDE's" from HS25. Hence, to attend the lecture it is strongly recommended to have attended the first part, too.
The following knowledge is assumed:
- Standard courses in mathematical analysis and linear algebra, such as Analysis I & II, Lineare Algebra, reelle Analysis, Funktionalanalysis or equivalent.
- Some (possibly applied, from physics etc) knowledge of PDE's.
- Standard courses in numerical analysis, such as Einf. in die Numerik, Numerik der Diff.-Gl.
- Good knowledge of Finite Element Methods for elliptic problems (e.g. by attending the course Numerical Methods for PDE's in the fall)
- Working knowledge in one programming language such as Matlab or Python.
Language of instruction	English
Use of digital media	No specific media used
Course auditors welcome
